## DecodingError

```k,ignore
public enum DecodingError implements Error, Codable, Equatable
```

Why decoding JSON into a [`Codable`](k-core.md#codable) type failed.

**Members**

- `case malformed(message: String)`
  The text isn't JSON; `message` says where parsing stopped.
- `case mismatch(path: String, message: String)`
  The JSON doesn't have the type's shape: `path` locates the value
  that doesn't fit.

## FetchHttpClient

```k,ignore
public service FetchHttpClient implements HttpClient
```

The standard [`HttpClient`](#httpclient), built on the web-standard `fetch`.

**Members**

- `func send(request: HttpRequest) async throws HttpError -> HttpResponse`
  Sends `request` with `fetch`.

  - Parameter request: the request to send.
  - Returns: the response, with any status.
  - Throws: [`HttpError.offline`](#httperror) when the server can't be reached and
    [`HttpError.timeout`](#httperror) when the request's timeout elapses.

## HttpBody

```k,ignore
public enum HttpBody
```

The body of an outgoing request or of a response. Each case sets
`Content-Type`.

**Members**

- `case json(Codable)`
  A [`Codable`](k-core.md#codable) value encoded as JSON (`application/json`).
- `case text(String)`
  UTF-8 text (`text/plain`).
- `case form(Map<String, String>)`
  Form fields, encoded as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.
- `case bytes(Bytes, contentType: String)`
  Raw bytes with an explicit `contentType`.

## HttpClient

```k,ignore
@Platform(side: .both)
public interface HttpClient
```

Calls external HTTP APIs (`docs/design/32-http-client.md`). A platform
interface usable on both sides and injectable only into services; its one
implementation, [`FetchHttpClient`](#fetchhttpclient), is injected with no `use` rule.

**Members**

- `func send(request: HttpRequest) async throws HttpError -> HttpResponse`
  Sends `request` and returns the response, whatever its status.

  A non-2xx response is still a response: check
  [`HttpResponse.isSuccess`](#httpresponse), or use `fetchJson(request:)`.

  - Parameter request: the request to send.
  - Returns: the response, with any status.
  - Throws: [`HttpError.offline`](#httperror) or [`HttpError.timeout`](#httperror), never
    [`HttpError.status`](#httperror).
- `func fetchJson<T>(request: HttpRequest) async throws HttpError -> T where T implements Codable`
  Sends the request, requires a 2xx status, and decodes the body as
  JSON into a [`Codable`](k-core.md#codable) type, written out (`fetchJson<Forecast>(…)`)
  or given by the binding.

  - Parameter request: the request to send.
  - Returns: the decoded body.
  - Throws: what `send(request:)` throws, [`HttpError.status`](#httperror) for a
    non-2xx response (with its body), and [`HttpError.decoding`](#httperror) when
    the body isn't the expected JSON.

## HttpError

```k,ignore
public enum HttpError implements Error, Codable
```

Why an [`HttpClient`](#httpclient) call failed (`docs/design/32-http-client.md`,
"Errors"). Services map it to their own error enum.

**Members**

- `case offline`
  The server couldn't be reached: a DNS failure, a refused
  connection or no network.
- `case timeout`
  The request's [`HttpRequest.timeout`](#httprequest) elapsed.
- `case status(HttpStatus, body: String)`
  A non-2xx response, from [`HttpClient.fetchJson`](#httpclient), with the third
  party's body.
- `case decoding(message: String)`
  The body wasn't the expected JSON.

## HttpHeaders

```k,ignore
public struct HttpHeaders
```

The headers of a received request or response. Names are lowercased, so
lookups don't depend on the sender's capitalization: `headers["x-id"]`.

**Members**

- `func get(_ name: String) -> String?`
  Returns the value of the header `name`, matched in any case.

  - Returns: the value, the values joined with `, ` if the header is
    repeated, or `nil` if it is absent.
- `func all(_ name: String) -> List<String>`
  Returns every value of the header `name`, in order; empty if it is
  absent.

## HttpMethod

```k,ignore
public enum HttpMethod implements Equatable, Hashable, Codable
```

An HTTP request method.

**Members**

- `case get`
  The `GET` method: read a resource.
- `case post`
  The `POST` method: submit data or create a resource.
- `case put`
  The `PUT` method: replace a resource.
- `case patch`
  The `PATCH` method: change part of a resource.
- `case delete`

- `case head`
  The `HEAD` method: `GET` without the body.

## HttpRequest

```k,ignore
@Builder
public struct HttpRequest
```

An outgoing HTTP request (`docs/design/32-http-client.md`, "Requests").

A `@Builder` struct: the method and URL are named arguments and every
other field is a chained method,
`HttpRequest(method: .get, url: u).query(["q": text]).timeout(10.seconds)`.

**Members**

- `let method: HttpMethod`
  The request method ([`HttpMethod`](#httpmethod)).
- `let url: Url`
  The absolute URL.
- `let query: Map<String, String> = [:]`
  Query parameters, appended to `url`.
- `let headers: Map<String, String> = [:]`
  Headers to send.
- `let secretHeaders: Map<String, Secret<String>> = [:]`
  Headers whose values are secrets, redacted in logs.
- `let bearerToken: Secret<String>? = nil`
  A token sent as `Authorization: Bearer …`; none when `nil`.
- `let body: HttpBody? = nil`
  The body ([`HttpBody`](#httpbody)), which also sets `Content-Type`; none when
  `nil`.
- `let timeout: Duration = 30.seconds`
  How long to wait for a response before [`HttpError.timeout`](#httperror).

## HttpResponse

```k,ignore
public struct HttpResponse
```

An HTTP response: received from [`HttpClient`](#httpclient), or sent by an endpoint
page's handler (`docs/design/32-http-client.md`, "Responses").

It follows the builder rule: the status is a named argument and the
headers and body are chained, `HttpResponse(status: .ok).body(.text("ok"))`.

**Members**

- `init(status: HttpStatus)`
  Creates a response with `status`, no headers and no body.
- `static func redirect(to page: Page) -> HttpResponse`
  Returns a `303 See Other` response to `page`, a page of the app.
- `static func redirect(url: Url) -> HttpResponse`
  Returns a `303 See Other` response to an external `url`.
- `func headers(_ headers: Map<String, String>) -> HttpResponse`
  Returns the response with `headers` added. Setting `set-cookie` is
  a compile error for a literal name.
- `func body(_ body: HttpBody) -> HttpResponse`
  Returns the response with `body` ([`HttpBody`](#httpbody)), which also sets
  `Content-Type`.
- `var status: HttpStatus`
  The status ([`HttpStatus`](#httpstatus)).
- `var isSuccess: Bool`
  `true` for a 2xx status.
- `var headers: HttpHeaders`
  The headers, names lowercased ([`HttpHeaders`](#httpheaders)).
- `var bodyBytes: Bytes`
  The body exactly as received.
- `var body: String`
  The body as UTF-8 text.
- `func json<T>() throws HttpError -> T where T implements Codable`
  Decodes the body as JSON into a [`Codable`](k-core.md#codable) type, given by the
  binding.

  - Returns: the decoded body.
  - Throws: [`HttpError.decoding`](#httperror) when the body isn't the expected
    JSON.

## HttpStatus

```k,ignore
public enum HttpStatus implements Equatable, Hashable, Codable
```

An HTTP status (`docs/design/32-http-client.md`, "HttpStatus"). Named
statuses are cases; any other code is `.other(Int)`, which never holds a
code that has a name (`.other(503)` is a compile error).

**Members**

- `case ok`
  The request succeeded: OK.

  200.
- `case created`
  A resource was created: Created.

  201.
- `case accepted`
  The request was accepted for later processing: Accepted.

  202.
- `case noContent`
  The request succeeded with no body: No Content.

  204.
- `case movedPermanently`
  The resource has a new permanent URL: Moved Permanently.

  301.
- `case seeOther`
  The answer is at another URL, fetched with `GET`: See Other.

  303.
- `case notModified`
  The cached copy is still valid: Not Modified.

  304.
- `case badRequest`
  The request is malformed: Bad Request.

  400.
- `case unauthorized`
  The request needs authentication: Unauthorized.

  401.
- `case forbidden`
  The caller may not do this: Forbidden.

  403.
- `case notFound`
  Nothing exists at the URL: Not Found.

  404.
- `case methodNotAllowed`
  The URL doesn't accept the method: Method Not Allowed.

  405.
- `case conflict`
  The request conflicts with the current state: Conflict.

  409.
- `case gone`
  The resource existed but was removed: Gone.

  410.
- `case payloadTooLarge`
  The body is larger than the server accepts: Payload Too Large.

  413.
- `case unsupportedMediaType`
  The body's content type isn't accepted: Unsupported Media Type.

  415.
- `case unprocessableEntity`
  The body is well-formed but invalid: Unprocessable Entity.

  422.
- `case tooManyRequests`
  The caller exceeded a rate limit: Too Many Requests.

  429.
- `case internalServerError`
  The server failed: Internal Server Error.

  500.
- `case badGateway`
  An upstream server answered badly: Bad Gateway.

  502.
- `case serviceUnavailable`
  The server can't answer for now: Service Unavailable.

  503.
- `case gatewayTimeout`
  An upstream server didn't answer in time: Gateway Timeout.

  504.
- `case other(Int)`
  Any code without a named case; the payload is the code, never one
  that has a name.
- `init(code: Int)`
  A status from an integer literal, validated to `100...599` at compile
  time: `HttpStatus(code: 418)` is `.other(418)`.
- `var code: Int`
  The numeric code.
- `var isSuccess: Bool`
  `true` for a 2xx (success) status.
- `var isClientError: Bool`
  `true` for a 4xx (client error) status.
- `var isServerError: Bool`
  `true` for a 5xx (server error) status.

## IncomingRequest

```k,ignore
@ServerOnly
public struct IncomingRequest
```

A request an endpoint page's handler receives
(`docs/design/27-endpoint-pages.md`, "The incoming request"). Server-only.

**Members**

- `var method: HttpMethod`
  The request method ([`HttpMethod`](#httpmethod)).
- `var url: Url`
  The absolute URL, built from `K_PUBLIC_ORIGIN`.
- `var query: Map<String, String>`
  The query string's parameters.
- `var headers: HttpHeaders`
  The headers, names lowercased ([`HttpHeaders`](#httpheaders)).
- `var rawBody: Bytes`
  The body exactly as received.
- `var clientAddress: String`
  The caller's address, honoring `K_TRUSTED_PROXIES`.
- `func text() -> String?`
  Returns the body as UTF-8 text, or `nil` if it isn't valid UTF-8.
- `func json<T>() throws DecodingError -> T where T implements Codable`
  Decodes the body as JSON into a [`Codable`](k-core.md#codable) type, given by the
  binding.

  - Returns: the decoded body.
  - Throws: [`DecodingError.malformed`](#decodingerror) when the body isn't JSON, and
    [`DecodingError.mismatch`](#decodingerror) when it doesn't have the type's shape.

## StandardWebSocketClient

```k,ignore
public service StandardWebSocketClient implements WebSocketClient
```

The standard [`WebSocketClient`](#websocketclient): the browser's `WebSocket` in the
browser, and a Rust client on the server.

**Members**

- `func connect(request: WebSocketRequest) async throws WebSocketError -> WebSocket`
  Opens a socket to the request's URL.

  - Parameter request: the request.
  - Returns: the open socket.
  - Throws: [`WebSocketError.offline`](#websocketerror), [`WebSocketError.timeout`](#websocketerror) or
    [`WebSocketError.refused`](#websocketerror).

## WebSocket

```k,ignore
public class WebSocket
```

An open WebSocket, from [`WebSocketClient.connect`](#websocketclient)
(`docs/design/44-channels.md`, "Raw WebSockets").

```k,ignore
let socket = try await sockets.connect(request: WebSocketRequest(url: feed))
try await socket.send(.text("{\"subscribe\": \"BTC-USD\"}"))

for await message in socket.messages {
    let tick: Tick = try message.json()
}
```

**Members**

- `let state: WebSocketState`
  `open`, `closing` or `closed(code:reason:)`; reactive.
- `let subprotocol: String?`
  The subprotocol the endpoint chose, or `nil`.
- `let messages: Stream<WebSocketMessage>`
  Every message the endpoint sends, in order; ends when the socket
  closes. Read once.
- `func send(_ message: WebSocketMessage) async throws WebSocketError`
  Sends `message`, waiting while more than 1 MB is still queued to go
  out.

  - Throws: [`WebSocketError.closed`](#websocketerror) once the socket is closing or
    closed, and [`WebSocketError.tooLarge`](#websocketerror) once it closed because an
    incoming message was over the request's `maxMessage`.
- `func close(code: Int = 1000, reason: String = "")`
  Closes the socket with `code` and `reason`; idempotent.

## WebSocketClient

```k,ignore
@Platform(side: .both)
public interface WebSocketClient
```

Opens WebSockets to third-party endpoints that speak their own protocol:
an exchange's price feed, a chat bridge, a local device
(`docs/design/44-channels.md`, "Raw WebSockets"). A platform interface
usable on both sides and injectable only into services; its one
implementation, [`StandardWebSocketClient`](#standardwebsocketclient), is injected with no `use`
rule, and [`k.test.TestWebSocketClient`](k-test.md#testwebsocketclient) replaces it in tests.

Nothing reconnects by itself, since the runtime can't know how to
resubscribe to someone else's protocol: a loop that waits
[`k.time.Backoff.next`](k-time.md#backoff) between attempts uses the channels' delays.

**Members**

- `func connect(request: WebSocketRequest) async throws WebSocketError -> WebSocket`
  Opens a socket to the request's URL and waits for the handshake.

  The socket belongs to the run that opened it: when that run is
  cancelled (the page is left, the effect re-runs) the socket closes.

  - Parameter request: the URL, and optionally a subprotocol, headers
    (server-only) and limits.
  - Returns: the open socket.
  - Throws: [`WebSocketError.offline`](#websocketerror) when the endpoint can't be
    reached, [`WebSocketError.timeout`](#websocketerror) when the handshake takes longer
    than the request's `timeout`, and [`WebSocketError.refused`](#websocketerror) when
    the endpoint answered without upgrading (on the server; a browser
    doesn't say why, so there it is `offline`).

## WebSocketError

```k,ignore
public enum WebSocketError implements Error, Codable
```

Why a [`WebSocketClient`](#websocketclient) call or a [`WebSocket.send`](#websocket) failed
(`docs/design/44-channels.md`, "Raw WebSockets").

**Members**

- `case offline`
  The endpoint couldn't be reached, or the browser refused the
  handshake without saying why.
- `case timeout`
  The handshake took longer than the request's `timeout`.
- `case refused(status: HttpStatus)`
  The endpoint answered the handshake without upgrading (on the
  server, which sees the answer).
- `case tooLarge`
  An incoming message was over the request's `maxMessage`, so the
  socket closed (code 1009).
- `case closed`
  The socket is closing or closed.

## WebSocketMessage

```k,ignore
public enum WebSocketMessage implements Equatable
```

One WebSocket message: text or binary.

**Members**

- `case text(String)`
  A text message.
- `case binary(Bytes)`
  A binary message.
- `func json<T>() throws DecodingError -> T where T implements Codable`
  Decodes the message, text or UTF-8 bytes, as JSON into a
  [`Codable`](k-core.md#codable) type, written out or given by the binding:
  `let tick = try message.json<Tick>()`.

  - Returns: the decoded value.
  - Throws: [`DecodingError.malformed`](#decodingerror) when it isn't JSON, and
    [`DecodingError.mismatch`](#decodingerror) when it doesn't have the type's shape.

## WebSocketRequest

```k,ignore
@Builder
public struct WebSocketRequest
```

What [`WebSocketClient.connect`](#websocketclient) opens (`docs/design/44-channels.md`,
"Raw WebSockets").

A `@Builder` struct like [`HttpRequest`](#httprequest): the URL is a named argument and
every other field is a chained method,
`WebSocketRequest(url: Url("wss://feed.example/v1")).subprotocol("feed.v2")`.

**`headers`, `secretHeaders` and `bearerToken` are server-only:** a
browser can't send headers on a handshake, so setting them in code that
runs in the browser is a compile error (K4031), and a token in a header
never reaches client code.

**Members**

- `let url: Url`
  The `ws://` or `wss://` URL.
- `let subprotocol: String? = nil`
  The subprotocol to ask for (`Sec-WebSocket-Protocol`); none when
  `nil`.
- `let headers: Map<String, String> = [:]`
  Headers to send with the handshake. Server-only.
- `let secretHeaders: Map<String, Secret<String>> = [:]`
  Headers whose values are secrets, redacted in logs. Server-only.
- `let bearerToken: Secret<String>? = nil`
  A token sent as `Authorization: Bearer …`; none when `nil`.
  Server-only.
- `let timeout: Duration = 30.seconds`
  How long the handshake may take before [`WebSocketError.timeout`](#websocketerror).
- `let maxMessage: Int = 1_000_000`
  The largest incoming message, in bytes; a larger one closes the
  socket (code 1009) and the next `send` throws
  [`WebSocketError.tooLarge`](#websocketerror).

## WebSocketState

```k,ignore
public enum WebSocketState implements Equatable
```

Where a [`WebSocket`](#websocket) is.

**Members**

- `case open`
  Open: messages flow both ways.
- `case closing`
  `close` was called; the endpoint hasn't confirmed yet.
- `case closed(code: Int, reason: String)`
  Closed, with the close frame's code and reason (`1006` and an empty
  reason when the connection dropped without one).
